title: Milk To Creamer
description: A Vanilla+ mod that's meant to be simple and realistic to existing additions within Minecraft
body:
Additions:

  • Recipes for Totems, Tridents, and Chainmail Armor.
  • Chainmail Meshes for making Chainmail Armor.
  • The Redener (a block that will be for making redstone).
  • The Inventor Villager type, using the Redener block.
  • The Shardback, a turtle-like mob that will tackle the player.
